description: Run the package's test suite (or a filtered subset) using devtools::test(). Reports test results in the chosen format.

filter.description: Regex pattern to restrict which test files are run (e.g. 'my_func').

project_path.description: Absolute path to the root of the R package.

reporter.description: testthat reporter to use (e.g. 'progress', 'summary'). Defaults to 'progress'.

name: test
